import { EventEmitter } from "node:events";
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { renderAnsi } from "./render";

export interface PreviewOptions {
  /** The job to follow, for example "build-142". */
  job: string;
  /** Keep streaming new output after the first screen. */
  follow?: boolean;
  /** Panel width in terminal columns. */
  width?: number;
}

export interface Preview extends EventEmitter {
  done: Promise<void>;
}

const DEFAULT_WIDTH = 60;

export function createPreview({ job, follow = false, width = DEFAULT_WIDTH }: PreviewOptions): Preview {
  const preview = new EventEmitter() as Preview;
  const args = ["logs", job, ...(follow ? ["--follow"] : [])];
  const child = spawn("widget-agent", args, { stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "inherit"] });

  let buffer = "";
  child.stdout.setEncoding("utf8");
  child.stdout.on("data", (chunk: string) => {
    buffer += chunk;
    const lines = buffer.split("\n");
    buffer = lines.pop() ?? "";
    for (const line of lines) preview.emit("line", renderAnsi(line, width));
  });

  preview.done = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    child.on("error", reject);
    child.on("close", (code) => (code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error(`preview exited with ${code}`))));
  });

  return preview;
}
